name: 01-fire
change: EMOTION: Fired up / excitement. Mascot is FIRED UP — small flames flicker around the edges, eyes WIDE OPEN with tiny FIRE FLAMES inside the pupils, eyebrows raised in excitement, mouth open in 'whoa!' expression. A few embers floating around.

name: 02-love
change: EMOTION: Love / adoration. Eyes turn into PINK HEARTS instead of pupils, soft pink blush on cheeks, gentle smile. Tiny pink HEART PARTICLES floating around the head replacing code-symbols.

name: 03-thinking
change: EMOTION: Thinking deeply. Mascot has one arm raised, finger touching the chin/edge, eyes slightly squinted in concentration, eyebrows pulled together. Question mark '?' floating among the particles. EXACTLY 2 arms, no third hand.

name: 04-mind-blown
change: EMOTION: Mind blown. Top of the head / upper egg-white EXPLODING outward with cartoon explosion (yellow/orange burst, lightning bolts), eyes WIDE shocked with white pupils, mouth open in shock. Particles scatter outward.

name: 05-loading
change: EMOTION: Sleeping / loading. Eyes CLOSED with simple curved lines (sleep-eyes), small floating Z's above the head replacing other particles, very relaxed expression, slight smile. A tiny clock or hourglass particle suggesting wait.
